title: Studio/Setup: show the "storage not synced" warning a save or publish now returns (object-storage-sync-refused)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyvF7SP65frVFAYLv7

Filing gate: ① the ui half #30635 named as its own card "once the server field exists" (#30635 body, Expected, third bullet); the server half landed in PR #30691 (merge commit `55a00ba200`). ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3.
Dedupe: `object-storage-sync-refused`, `advisories warning after save` — no open card. **New.**
Reader: the `ui/**` lane (Studio / Setup object editor).

## What happens

Since PR #30691, `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` (publish mode) and `POST /api/v1/meta/object/NAME/publish` answer a refused storage sync with `200` plus one `warning` on `advisories` (rule `object-storage-sync-refused`, `path` empty, a `message` naming the object, and a `hint`). The console's object save does not show it, so the admin still sees plain success and learns that the table was not created only when reads or writes fail.

## Expected

- After a save or publish whose answer carries an `object-storage-sync-refused` advisory, the editor shows a warning with the advisory's `message` and `hint` (the save itself stays a success).
- If the console already renders `advisories` generically, this card is a check that it does so on the object save, plus a pin.
- Related: #30693 (the package-draft batch door still drops it on the server side).
